blocks.raw: > With more people using mobile devices and more ways to deliver content, dealing with your images and videos can be challenging. Akamai's Image and Video Manager gives you the control you need to expertly manage them and fully engage your web visitors.
blocks.text: With more people using mobile devices and more ways to deliver content, dealing with your images and videos can be challenging. Akamai's Image and Video Manager gives you the control you need to expertly manage them and fully engage your web visitors.
